title: A BAR WITH NOTHING TO DO FOLDS AWAY
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. On the Mainframe a full width greyed NOTHING COMPLETED TO CLAIM bar sat over the contracts, and on the stash a full width NOTHING TO SELL bar, the widest things on those screens and the ones that did nothing. They now show only when there is something to claim or sell.
now: The claim and sell bars show only when there is something to claim or sell.

edits.replacement:
_sb.disabled=!_sn;
    _sb.style.display=_sn?'':'none';   // vNN.xx (ui5q2n): with nothing to sell the full width greyed bar folds away
